what: Phase 0 look test, round 2 (look B with pixel-art textures, lit windows, lit 48 px cat, foreground framing and the miniature bokeh blur). Per-frame cost in milliseconds (CPU + GPU, GPU forced to finish with a 1x1 readPixels each frame), 120-200 frames per row, scene = market street at dusk with camera sway on.
notFps: These are frame costs, NOT frames per second. The in-app browser pane throttles requestAnimationFrame: it was hidden for most runs, and even when visible and unfocused its frame cadence was capped near 30 Hz (a Bench-all run recorded p50 intervals of about 30.6 ms for four configurations, and about 1 s for the last two when it was throttled again). Costs come from a synchronous render loop that does not depend on requestAnimationFrame. Press Bench all in a focused browser window for real FPS.

machine.gpu: ANGLE (AMD, AMD Radeon(TM) Graphics (0x000015BF) Direct3D11 vs_5_0 ps_5_0, D3D11)
machine.mode: Next.js dev server (not an optimised production build), Windows 11

tiers.settings: MSAA 4x, half-float buffer, 56-tap blur, all effects
render scale 0.75, SMAA instead of MSAA, 8-bit buffer, 24-tap blur, 1024 shadow map, 2 point lights, no grain
render scale 0.6, no post-processing, no shadows, no point lights

tiers.note: The outline pass renders the scene twice, so draw calls nearly double.

profile.note: One feature switched off at a time, look B, tier full, 1600x900. The baseline drifts by 1-3 ms between runs, so differences under about 1 ms are noise.
profile.reading: 4x multisampling costs about 4 ms, bloom about 2.5 ms, an 8-bit buffer saves about 1.4 ms. Nothing else moves the number, and a floor of about 13 ms remains with multisampling off. Removing 150 draw calls (shadows) changed nothing, and the minimal tier with 315 draw calls and no post-processing still costs about 8 ms at only 0.5 megapixels. The remaining cost is therefore NOT explained by this data. A likely candidate is per-draw overhead from many separate meshes and materials in the main pass (about 350 draws), but that is a hypothesis: it needs GPU timer queries and a merged-geometry experiment in Phase 1.
